negative

value.reason: In terraform/networking.tf, the aws_lb_listener on port 80 uses protocol "HTTP" and its default action forwards traffic straight to the juice_shop target group. It does not redirect to HTTPS, so application traffic crosses the load balancer unencrypted. This matches the positive example, where an HTTP listener forwards, and not the negative example, where the listener redirects to 443/HTTPS. The application handles personal profile data: models/address.ts defines a fullName field. That data would be sent in cleartext and could be intercepted, which is CWE-319. Not encrypting personal data in transit falls short of the encryption safeguards required by DPDP Rule 6(1)(a). The 'Internal-Restricted' exposure label does not undo this, because the listener config shows no TLS at any point and the evidence does not show the load balancer is internal-only.
